For binary s_j,t_j,u_j, if s_j=t_j the left side is 0; otherwise u_j equals exactly one of the two distinct endpoints and the right side is 1. Thus the coordinate triangle inequality follows directly from the declared binary alphabet. No extra absolute-value theorem or edit is necessary for this special coordinate inequality.

Twice that tail tends to 0 as well, supplying both epsilon choices. No missing mathematical prerequisite: the decay follows immediately from the cited convergence and tail identity.

The Definition names only the maximal-solution theorem for the state-Lipschitz condition, whose own Statement abbreviates it as Picard-Lindelof hypotheses. The local Picard supplier and def-locally-lipschitz-in-the-state-variable give the exact uniform compact-cylinder condition transitively. This is a precision gap, not a counterexample to well-definedness. Record nonfatal precision finding for producer batch 1: explicitly identify the local-Lipschitz definition and state its single finite constant on each compact time-state cylinder. The owned pulse field is smooth on the full product domain and satisfies that exact condition independently.
